title: closing-bible families (families.json)
description: PRD §4 'Source census': 'Group … potential document families by title, parties, date, version indicators and substantive similarity.' A family is one document across its versions and duplicates. Produced by script from the manifest alone (hash groups, then normalised title_hint, then sigpack agreement names and checklist rows when supplied). Every distinct manifest id appears in exactly one family; the script refuses to write otherwise. Shown to the user at Gate 1, who may split or merge; the confirmed file is what reconciliation reads.

checklist_sha256.description: sha256 of the checklist.json bytes the families were bound against; null when none was supplied. Reconciliation refuses a checklist whose hash differs, and refuses a checklist when this is null: rows bound at the families stage must be the rows reconciled, so run families with the same --checklist first.

family_id.description: sha256 over the sorted member ids, first 12 hex. Same members, same id, across runs.

sigpack_agreement.description: The sigpack ledger agreement this family matched, when a current ledger was supplied and a member's path equals a ledger signature_pages[].file.

checklist_ref.description: The user checklist row this family matched, when a checklist was supplied.
